description: A prompt submitted for sending to a model. The bytes are a detached object at contentRef; the artifact's name is the hash of this spec, so the same bytes recorded with a different mediaType, role, or session are a second artifact citing the same object.

claims: the bytes at contentRef were submitted as a prompt by the recorded actor at the recorded position on the chain, with the recorded role, media type, and session

the key recorded as the actor signed this request over its canonical bytes, and the authority it cited resolved, link by link, to a root on this same chain — both re-derivable offline from the bundle alone
doesNotClaim: that they are the whole of what the model saw

that any person, office, or organization holds the key that signed — the record binds the act to a key and the key to the authority it acted under, and neither to anyone; a reader who wants a name pins a root key and owns the pin
